data.body_html:
When chartering a boat in Marbella, fuel costs can be a major concern — but with our all-inclusive pricing, you never pay extra at the pump. Still, understanding fuel consumption helps you choose the right boat for your budget and itinerary. Here we compare the Astondoa 40 vs Azimut 39 vs Mangusta 80 on fuel efficiency, range, and overall value in Marbella.

Astondoa 40: Compact and Efficient

The Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) is a sleek motor yacht with a fuel burn of approximately 100-130 litres per hour at cruising speed (~22 kts). With a tank capacity of ~800 L, it offers a range of 6-8 hours — perfect for a day trip to Cabopino or Cala del Faro. At Marbella diesel prices (~€1.50/L), that's €150-195/h. It departs from Puerto Banús and is priced at €749/2h (Tier A), including fuel, skipper, drinks, snacks, and 21% IVA.

Azimut 39: Slightly More Power, Same Tier

The Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) burns a bit more: 120-150 L/h at cruising speed (~24 kts), costing €180-225/h in fuel. Its tank is similar (~800 L), giving 5-7 hours of range. Despite the higher fuel burn, it's also Tier A pricing at €749/2h — so you pay the same as the Astondoa 40 but get capacity for 11 guests. Perfect for larger groups wanting a lively cruise from Puerto Banús to Marbella Marina or Estepona.

Mangusta 80: Luxury with a Jet Ski

The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is a different league. With twin engines burning 270-400 L/h (depending on speed), fuel costs range from €405 to €600/h. At displacement speed (~10 kts), you get ~8 hours of range; at planing (~28 kts), ~4 hours. It's Tier B pricing from €4,719/4h, which includes a free jet ski. This boat is ideal for a premium day trip to Sotogrande or the Golden Mile, where you can anchor and enjoy water toys.

Which Boat Gives Best Value?

For short trips (2-4 hours), the Astondoa 40 offers the lowest fuel consumption and the same Tier A price as the Azimut 39. If you need space for 11, the Azimut 39 is worth the slight fuel premium. The Mangusta 80 is for those wanting luxury, space, and a free jet ski — fuel is included, so the cost is predictable. All depart from Puerto Banús, the heart of Marbella's boating scene. Check our full fleet for more options.

Fuel-Saving Tips for Your Charter

  • Cruise at displacement speed (8-10 kts) to cut fuel burn by 30-40% — perfect for scenic trips along the coast.
  • Plan shorter itineraries: a 2-hour sunset cruise from Puerto Banús to La Concha view uses less fuel than a full-day trip to Estepona.
  • Choose a Tier A boat (Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39) for budget-friendly charters under €1,000.
  • For larger groups, the Mangusta 80's all-inclusive price spreads the cost across 12 pax, making it competitive per person.

Remember: fuel is always included in our charter prices. No surprises. Book your Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 for a cost-effective day out, or go for the Mangusta 80 for a premium experience with a jet ski. All depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella.
